paite: Huan Mosi in Israel tengteng asamkhawm a, akiang uah: Israel mite aw, na sin ua na zuih ding uh dante, vaihawmte tuni a na bil ua na zak ua ka gen ngaikhia un.
heading: Thupiak Sawmte / (Eks 20.1-17)

paite: TOUPA Pathian in Horeb ah eite toh kikal ah thu akhung hi.
TOUPA'N hiai thu i pi-le-pute kiang ah ana khung kei a, eite, tutan a hingdam a om lai tengteng kiang ah ahi, akhun zawk.
TOUPA'N tang ah mei a pan kimaituah in hon houpih a,
huai lai in TOUPA thu nou hon kawkmuh ding in TOUPA toh na kikal uah ka dingh a; meikuang ziak in lah na lau ngal ua, tang ah na hohtou kei uhi.
Kei TOUPA Pathian, Aigupta gam a saltanna inn a pan hon pikhepa ka hi.
Ka ma ah keimah lou ngal pathian dangte na nei ding ahi kei.
Milim bawltawm, tunglam van a om hiam, nuailam lei a om hiam, lei nuailam a tui a om hiam, akoi batpih mahmah na kibawl ding ahi kei.

Huaite ma ah na kun ding uh ahi kei a, a-nna uh leng na sem ding uh ahi ahi kei. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh Pathian mullit hat, pate khelhna ziak a tate gawt zel, hon mudahte suan thumna leh suan lina tan a gawt zel leh;
ahon itte, ka thupiakte zuimi sang tampite tung a hehpihna langsak zel ka hi.
TOUPA na Pathian min na lou mawkmawk ding ahi kei. TOUPA'N amin lou mawkmawkte lah moh lou in akhah ngal kei ding hi.
TOUPA na Pathian in thu hon piak bang in Sabbath ni tang siangthou in.
Ni guk sung nna na sem dia, nna tengteng na sem ding ahi.

Ani sagih ni, TOUPA na Pathian a ding in Sabbath ni ahi. Huai ni in nang, na tapa, na tanu, na sikhapa, na sikhanu, na bawngtal, na sabiltung, na gante uh lak a akoi mahmah in leng, na inn a gamdang mite'n leng nna himhim asem ding uh ahi kei. Nangmah bang in na sikhapate, na sikhanute leng akhawl ding uh ahi.

Nang leng Aigupta gam ah sikha na hi khin a, TOUPA na Pathian in huai a pan khut hat leh ban zak a, hon pikhiak na hi, chih theigige in. Huaiziak in ahi, TOUPA na Pathian in Sabbath ni tang dia thu ahon piak.
TOUPA na Pathian in thu ahon piak bang in na nu leh na pa zahtak in. Huchi in TOUPA'N gam ahon piak ah lamzang in, na damsawt ding hi.
Tual na that ding ahi kei.
Ang na kawm ding ahi kei.
Na gu ding ahi kei.
Na invengte tung ah theihpih taklou in na pang ding ahi kei.
"Na invengte zi na eng ding ahi kei, na invengte inn hiam, alou hiam, asikhapa hiam, asikhanu hiam, abawngtal hiam, asabiltung hiam, na invengte thil bangmah na eng ding ahi kei," achi hi.
Hiai thute tang a mei, meipi leh mial sah bikbek a pan TOUPA'N aw ngaihtak in na vek ua kikhawmte kiang ah agen a, abehlap nawn tuan kei hi. Huaite suangpek nih a gelh in, kei kiang ah hon pia hi.
Tang akat lai a, mial a pan aw na zak un, hichi ahong hi a, na nam ua intekpen teng leh na upate un hon naih uhen.
heading: Mipite Lauhna / (Eks 20.18-21)

paite: Nou ngai in, "TOUPA i Pathian in i kiang uah athupidan leh aletdan alangsak a, mei a pan a-aw i za uh. Pathian in mihing ahoupih a leng na sih tuanlouhdan uh tuni in na theita uhi.
Huaiziak in bangziak a si ding i hi ua? Hiai meikuang thupitak in hon kangmang mai ding. TOUPA i Pathian aw i zak nawnleh zaw i si mai ding uhi.
Meikuang a pan Pathian hing aw i zak bang a za sam a lah hing ngal mihing tengteng lak ah kua a-om a?

Nang va naih inla, TOUPA i Pathian in agen ding tengteng va ngaikhe dih ve. TOUPA i Pathian in na kiang a, agen tengteng kou kiang ah na gen dia; huchi in ka na ngaikhe ding ua, ka zui ding uh," na chi uhi.
N'on houpih lai ua na thugen uh TOUPA'N ana za a; huchi in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Hiai mipite'n na kiang a thu agen uh ka na za a; athugen tengteng uh agen hoih uhi.
Huchibang lungsim pu gige le uh aw, laudan ahong siam ding ua, ka thupiak azui gige ding ua, amau leh atate uh tangtawn in alamzang ding uhi.
Pai inla, apuanin ua kik nawn ding in amaute hilh in.
Himahleh aluah ding ua ka piak ding gam a azuih ding ua na sinsak ding thupiak, dan thuseh leh dante tengteng ka hon piaktheihna ding in nang zaw hiai ah om tadih in,” achi hi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA na Pathian un thu ahon piak bang a hih ding in pilvang un. Taklam ah hiam, veilam ah hiam na pial ding uh ahi kei.
Na va luah ding uh gam a na hin ua, na lamzanna ding uh leh na ten sawttheihna ding un, TOUPA na Pathian un thu hon piak lampi na zuih tawnsuak ding uh ahi.
